audit.notes: This template works for any profession, hobby, or creative path (e.g., 'Will I be rich as a software engineer / designer / climber?'). You can use existing b-roll clips from your library (gym/climbing for Health, friends/coffee for Community, park/travel for Experiences, laptop/morning routine for Discipline, etc.) paired with quick hook text and a long-form reflective caption.
audit.summary: A motivational montage answering whether nursing makes you rich, redefining wealth through clips showing compassion, community, fitness, travel experiences, discipline, faith, and purpose.
